title: A London Provisioner's Chronicle, 1550-1563, by Henry Machyn: Manuscript, Transcription, and Modernization
author: Henry Machyn
institution: University of Michigan Library / Michigan Publishing (editors Richard W. Bailey, Marilyn Miller and Colette Moore)
notes: Edition of the diary of the London merchant tailor Henry Machyn (British Library Cotton Vitellius F.v), 1550 to 1563, with manuscript images, a diplomatic transcript and a modern English rendering, browsable by year. The edition dates from 2006 and no update is evident. The counts treat the diary as one text, read from Internet Archive copies of the fulltext pages because the live site blocks automated access.
